source.stem: Which statement about polymers is correct?

options.text: Polymers are formed by breaking down monomers.
Polymers can be natural or synthetic.
Polymers contain atoms of only one element.
Polymers have a giant ionic structure.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Applies when the same measured volume of liquid is poured into differently shaped containers.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: container shape but fixed amount of liquid happens first, and that produces limited particle movement with continuing attraction.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when Applies when the same measured volume of liquid is poured into differently shaped containers is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: In liquids, particles can move and change positions within a limited space while remaining close enough under attraction, so liquids have no fixed shape but have a fixed volume. limited particle movement with continuing attraction -> container shape but fixed amount of liquid The learner explains that liquid particles move and change positions within a limited space while attractions keep them close, so the liquid takes container shape but keeps its measured volume. A liquid changes both shape and volume whenever its container changes.
